findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
(REEPAT) 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

On arrival the hand sink in the bathroom is without acceptable soap options. The PIC was notified and stated that the bathroom was not for customers. The inspector stated that the employees still needed to be able to effectively wash their hands. A follow up is being set for ten days to ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

On arrival the hand sink in the bathroom is without a hand drying option. The PIC was notified and stated that the bathroom was not for customers. The inspector stated that the employees still needed to be able to effectively wash their hands. A follow up is being set for ten days to ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306. 

The fountain drink machine in the facility is not currently in use. The nozzles are still heavily soiled however and need cleaned. The PIC was notified and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. Ensure that all equipment is maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Numerous ceiling tiles throughout the facility are missing and several more have water damage. The PIC indicated that they were in the process of repairing these items. This is the same statement that has been documented on the previous inspection (two years ago) and needs to be fixed. The PIC is instructed to repair the ceiling and maintain it in a good state moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

1) The baseboards in the bathroom are either missing or peeling away from the wall. The PIC is instructed to repair/replace prior to the next routine inspection. 2) The door handle that leads into the room where the soda syrup is located is missing the handle. The PIC is instructed to repair/replace prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all facilities are maintained in good condition at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Dust and mold are observed on the fan covers, ceiling and walls of the walk in cooler. The PIC is instructed to clean and to maintain it clean at all times moving forward. Ensure that the facilities are maintained clean at all times

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

On arrival there was not a supply of soap by the hand sink in the bathroom. A supply of soap was supplied during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The ceiling tiles in the bathrooms as well as in the short hallway leading into the bathrooms are either missing or water damaged. Replace prior to the next routine inspection. Also, ensure that they are not acoustic types. They should be smooth an easily cleanable.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
No toilet tissue present in the restroom. CORRECTED. Ref. 6-302.11 [Pf]

No trash receptacle present in the restroom. Provide a covered receptacle. Correct by next routine inspection. Ref. 5-502.27 [C]

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
(REPEATx2) Observed boxes of food stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. Food must be at least 6" off the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the following items to be in disrepair: 1) Frost accumulation in the two chest freezers. Defrost these coolers,
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed boxes of styrofoam cups stored on the floor in the back area. No soda dispensers are at the facility currently, all single service items must be at least 6" off the floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed waste water stored in the mop bucket. Waste  water must be dumped after each use.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the handwashing sink to be blocked. Since the facility is doing just pre-packaged food only (no soda fountain or ice) the handsink will need to be accessible when food comes.
750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...

750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
